title: Exhibitions “FOSILORAMA” and “MINERALIS – the Pelagonian Massif” now open
excerpt: The Gallery of the Natural History Museum on Kalemegdan has opened the exhibitions “FOSILORAMA” and “MINERALIS – the Pelagonian Massif”, in collaboration with the Natural History Museum in Skopje.

title: Exhibition "Fossils as Reflections of the Past" opened in Žagubica!
excerpt: Exhibition "Fossils as Reflections of the Past" opened in Žagubica! The Natural History Museum's exhibition "Fossils as Reflections of the Past" was ceremonially opened at the Homolje Heritage Museum in Žagubica.

title: We look forward to our exhibition "Fossils as Reflections of the Past" travelling to Žagubica.
excerpt: We look forward to our exhibition "Fossils as Reflections of the Past" travelling to Žagubica. ANNOUNCEMENT: OPENING OF THE EXHIBITION "FOSSILS AS REFLECTIONS OF THE PAST" at the Homolje Heritage Museum in Žagubica.

title: Exhibition "Masters of the Depths – sharks and rays of the Adriatic Sea" opened at the Gallery of the Natural History Museum
excerpt: "Masters of the Depths – sharks and rays of the Adriatic Sea". The sharks and rays of the Adriatic Sea have arrived in Belgrade. The exhibition has opened at the Gallery of the Natural History Museum on Kalemegdan.

title: The Natural History Museum in Belgrade announces a call for professional internships
excerpt: The Natural History Museum in Belgrade announces a call for professional internships, offering students the opportunity to gain experience in field research methods in botany, plant preparation and the maintenance of plant collections.
